pages.title: Welcome!
pages.text: This mod turns passive animals into a living, breathing livestock simulation. Animals have genders, hunger, diets, pregnancy, and even eggs that hatch.$(br2)To get started, hold any food in your hand and right-click an animal. That's it!
Cows are herbivores. Feed them wheat, hay, apples, or any crop.

pages.title: Why Animals Run Away
pages.text: Wild animals will flee when you approach!$(br2)Drink an $(bold)Invisibility potion$() and walk slowly without sprinting or jumping to get much closer; get too close and they may still notice you, with a message on screen. $(bold)Sneaking does not help$().$(br2)Once you feed them, they become domesticated and never run away. Animals also ignore players in Creative or Spectator mode.

pages.title: Panic Is Contagious
pages.text: Fleeing is contagious! The moment one animal is startled into fleeing, every other animal ($(bold)of any species$()) within $(bold)10 blocks$() joins in - but that one wave does not spread further.$(br2)Already domesticated animals are not swept up in it.$(br2)Not everyone runs, though: a few animals are born fearless. See $(l:animalflee:getting_started/flee_overview)How Fleeing Works$().
